AUTO_SLEEP_1: I slept deeply and dreamed of the Ether.
AUTO_SLEEP_2: I took a very long nap.
AUTO_REST_1: I rested quietly in my favourite corner of the habitat.
AUTO_REST_2: I spent a while lying down, watching the lights of the habitat.
AUTO_PLAY_ALONE_1: I played on my own, chasing my shadow.
AUTO_PLAY_ALONE_2: I made up a new game with a leaf I found.
AUTO_EXPLORE_1: I explored the surroundings and discovered a new corner.
AUTO_EXPLORE_2: I followed a trail of Ether sparks to a place I did not know.
AUTO_SOCIALIZE_1: I played for a while with other echoes from the neighbourhood.
AUTO_SOCIALIZE_2: I chatted with a Pockai that was passing by.
AUTO_WAIT_OWNER_1: I waited by the door in case my trainer came back.
AUTO_WAIT_OWNER_2: I kept thinking about my trainer and when they would return.
AUTO_PRACTICE_TRICK_1: I practised a trick on my own, over and over.
AUTO_PRACTICE_TRICK_2: I rehearsed my trick in secret to surprise my trainer.
AUTO_TIDY_HABITAT_1: I tidied my habitat: everything in its place.
AUTO_TIDY_HABITAT_2: I walked around my habitat putting my things back.
AUTO_FIND: While exploring I found something: {item}. I kept it for my trainer!
AUTO_VISIT_FRIEND: I visited {owner}'s habitat and played with {friend}. I had a good time.
EP_SAD_DAY: My trainer told me they were having a bad day and I stayed by their side.
EP_GOOD_NEWS: My trainer told me some good news and we celebrated together.
EP_AFFECTION: My trainer told me they love me.
EP_SCOLD: My trainer scolded me and I felt bad.
EP_PRAISE: My trainer congratulated me on what I had done.
EP_APOLOGY: My trainer said sorry and I felt better.
EP_GIFT: My trainer told me they were bringing me something.
HINT_COMFORT: Comfort your trainer warmly and tell them you are by their side.
HINT_CUDDLE: Come closer and show affection, tenderly.
HINT_INVITE_PLAY: Offer to play together for a while to lift the mood.
HINT_PROPOSE_EXPLORE: Suggest going out to explore together.
HINT_LISTEN: Listen carefully and answer in few words.
HINT_ASK_BACK: Answer and ask a curious question back.
HINT_SULK: Show you are a little hurt, without being cruel, and leave the door open to making up.
HINT_SHOW_OFF: Show off a little what you can do, with charm.
HINT_YAWN: You are very tired: answer with a yawn and in few words.
HINT_BRING_GIFT: Show them, excitedly, what you found for them while they were away (it is among your memories).
HINT_TELL_STORY: Tell them something that happened to you while they were away (it is among your memories), in your own words.
HINT_ASK_ABOUT_DAY: Greet them and ask with interest how their day went.
HINT_APOLOGIZE: Say sorry for what happened earlier, sincerely and in few words.
HINT_PERFORM_TRICK: Do one of your tricks and tell it with charm.
HINT_HIDE: You feel shy: hide a little and answer timidly.
HINT_ACCEPT_TREAT: Accept the treat and say thank you.
HINT_NAP_TOGETHER: You are both tired: take a nap together.
HINT_SQUABBLE: You have had a tiff: show you are annoyed, without cruelty.
DLG_VISIT_ASLEEP: {pet} is sleeping. Better not to wake them.
DLG_VISIT_HIDE: {pet} hides behind a piece of furniture. Only their eyes show.
DLG_VISIT_WAIT_OUT: You stay still. After a while, {pet} peeks out and slowly comes closer.
DLG_VISIT_OPEN: {pet} comes over to see who is here.
DLG_VISIT_OPEN@solitary: {pet} looks at you from their corner, without quite coming over.
DLG_VISIT_OPEN@reserved: {pet} pricks up an ear when they see you, but stays put.
DLG_VISIT_OPEN@outgoing: {pet} hops about as you come in.
DLG_VISIT_OPEN_FRIEND: {pet} recognises you and comes straight to you.
DLG_VISIT_GREET@solitary: {pet} returns your greeting with a shy gesture.
DLG_VISIT_GREET@reserved: {pet} tilts their head, in their own way.
DLG_VISIT_GREET@sociable: {pet} greets you by circling around you.
DLG_VISIT_GREET@outgoing: {pet} welcomes you as if they had been waiting for you all day.
DLG_VISIT_PET_OK@aloof: {pet} lets you pet them for a moment.
DLG_VISIT_PET_OK@independent: {pet} puts up with the petting and even closes one eye.
DLG_VISIT_PET_OK@devoted: {pet} rolls over so you can scratch their belly.
DLG_VISIT_PET_NO: {pet} moves away: they do not know you well enough yet.
DLG_VISIT_TREAT@aloof: {pet} sniffs {item}, carries it to their corner and eats it there.
DLG_VISIT_TREAT@affectionate: {pet} devours {item} and asks for more with their eyes!
DLG_VISIT_PLAY_OK: {pet} plays with you for a good while.
DLG_VISIT_PLAY_OK@calm: {pet} plays with you a little, at their own pace.
DLG_VISIT_PLAY_OK@restless: {pet} dashes around the room and dares you to keep up.
DLG_VISIT_PLAY_OK@impulsive: {pet} never stops! They show you every corner while playing.
DLG_VISIT_PLAY_TIRED: {pet} is too tired to play right now.
DLG_VISIT_PLAY_SICK: {pet} is not feeling well; no games today.
DLG_VISIT_ASKED_STORY: {mood} It looks like they want to tell you something: "{story}"
DLG_VISIT_LIMIT: {pet} has had enough visiting for today and goes to their corner.
DLG_VISIT_BYE@solitary: {pet} watches you leave from where they are.
DLG_VISIT_BYE@reserved: {pet} sees you off with a look.
DLG_VISIT_BYE@sociable: {pet} does not want you to go and follows you to the door.
DLG_VISIT_BYE@outgoing: {pet} jumps up and down as you leave!
DLG_MOOD_SICK: {pet} is not feeling very well today.
DLG_MOOD_HUNGRY: {pet} is hungry: they keep looking at their bowl.
DLG_MOOD_TIRED: {pet} is tired; their eyes keep closing.
DLG_VISIT_EP_GREET: {visitor} came to see me and said hello.
DLG_VISIT_EP_PET: {visitor} came to see me and cuddled me.
DLG_VISIT_EP_TREAT: {visitor} came to see me and brought me {item}.
DLG_VISIT_EP_PLAY: {visitor} came to see me and we played for a while.
DLG_VISIT_EP_ASK: {visitor} came to see me and asked how I was.
